whyItMatters: Pip resolves these names against the configured index, so a name that only looks like the intended project delivers whatever that other project publishes. The name this rule expects is `celery`.
actions: Confirm the intended name against the package documentation the project already trusts and pin the declaration to that exact name; a name that is one edit away from a widely used package is a typo until the project can show it published the name itself. If the declaration was meant to be `celery`, correct it to that exact spelling.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm Pipfile no longer carries a declared requirement name in Pipfile within one edit of `celery`.
